module_summary: 1G Ethernet MAC with RGMII PHY interface: an RGMII-to-GMII adapter feeds a GMII MAC, while counter-based link-speed detection compares prescaled rx_clk against gtx_clk to set speed and MII select.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream payload into the MAC transmitter.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit stream valid into the MAC.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: MAC backpressure ready for the transmit stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received AXI-Stream payload from the MAC receiver.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Receive stream valid from the MAC.

anchors.name: rgmii_rxd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR receive nibbles into the PHY interface.

anchors.name: rgmii_txd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR transmit nibbles from the PHY interface.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive bytes from PHY adapter into MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit bytes from MAC into PHY adapter.

anchors.name: speed_reg
anchors.why: Detected link speed (10/100/1000) driving speed port and PHY clocking.

anchors.name: mii_select_reg
anchors.why: Selects MII vs GMII mode, synchronized into MAC tx/rx domains.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_1
anchors.why: gtx_clk reference counter; overflow implies 10M, magnitude distinguishes 100M.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_2
anchors.why: Counts prescaled rx_clk edges; overflow triggers 100M/1000M decision.

anchors.name: rx_prescale
anchors.why: rx_clk prescaler whose MSB is synchronized into gtx_clk for speed detection.

anchors.name: rx_prescale_sync
anchors.why: Synchronizer of prescaled rx_clk; edge enables rx_speed_count_2.

anchors.name: tx_mii_select_sync
anchors.why: Synchronizes mii_select into tx_clk domain for MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_clk_en
anchors.why: Transmit clock enable from PHY adapter gating MAC at lower speeds.

groups.name: RGMII PHY interface
groups.description: DDR RGMII to GMII conversion with generated rx/tx clocks and resets.

groups.name: Ethernet MAC
groups.description: GMII MAC converting AXI stream frames to/from GMII.

groups.name: Speed detection
groups.description: Measures rx_clk against gtx_clk to detect link speed and MII mode.
